name: vibesdk-harness-orchestrator-lambda
description: API Gateway HTTP API (v2) Lambda driving ECS RunTask/DescribeTasks/StopTask against aws/infra/harness's Fargate cluster, tracking sessionId -> task mapping in the vibesdk-harness-sessions DynamoDB table, proxying per-session calls to the right container's aws/agent-harness control-plane server, and sweeping idle sessions on an EventBridge schedule. Not part of the main vibesdk build.

scripts.package: npm run build && echo '{"type":"module"}' > dist/package.json && cd dist && zip -r ../harness-orchestrator-lambda.zip handler.js package.json
